title: Compliance Demand Orchestrator and Adaptive Routing for Enterprise Requests
creator: Elena Park
description: Build an orchestrator that triages, scores, and routes enterprise security & compliance requests (SOC2/ISO checklists, HIPAA/DPA questions, and vendor questionnaires). The Orchestrator should reduce manual handoffs and speed evidence delivery by: 1) routing requests to the correct lane (self-serve, product/engineering, security/legal), 2) auto-assembling evidence bundles from product telemetry, audit logs, and infra runbooks, and 3) surfacing templated responses and playbooks for common questionnaire items. This ticket covers product definition, scoring model, initial form/console surfaces, and Phase 1 integrations with Support, Security, and Legal.
background: Enterprise customers increasingly submit bespoke compliance packets. Current intake is ad-hoc by Sales/Solutions, causing long response cycles and duplicate work across Security, Legal, and Eng. We need a deterministic, auditable routing layer that codifies decisioning and reduces time-to-evidence.
goals: Reduce median time-to-first-response for compliance asks from 7 days to 48 hours
Auto-resolve low-risk, high-frequency questionnaire items for at least 30% of requests
Provide clear SLA lanes and escalation paths for high-risk cross-border DPAs and HIPAA requests
Create auditable evidence bundles that can be attached to outbound questionnaires and DPAs
acceptance_criteria: Structured intake form live in Console and Support flow with required routing metadata captured (region/data residency, request type, customer tier)
Priority/scoring model returns one of: auto-respond, product-owner queue, security-review, legal-review
Auto-evidence builder can assemble at least three evidence types (SOC2 artifact, data flow diagram, KMS audit snippet) and attach to outgoing responses
Playbook templates for the top 10 vendor questionnaire items available to triage owners
Audit log of routing decisions available in Console (per request) and accessible to Security/Legal
Operational runbook created for escalations and SLA exceptions
success_metrics: SLA compliance rate for P0/P1 compliance asks (target >= 95%)
Triage handoff reduction (target 40% fewer cross-team escalations)
Customer satisfaction for compliance responses (CSAT target >= 85%)
implementation_steps: Phase 0: Design: finalize intake schema and scoring features with Security/Legal/Support
Phase 1: Build intake API endpoint + Console form + Support flow; implement scoring service (rules + lightweight ML scorer)
Phase 1b: Wire templated responses and link to Confluence evidence artifacts
Phase 2: Implement auto-evidence bundler (connectors to telemetry, audit-log exports, config), attach generation to response path
Phase 3: Deep integrations: contract system for DPAs, document signing flow, and audit export for customer-facing packages
Phase 4: Iterate on scorer, add dynamic risk weights, add international data-flow detection for cross-border risk
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-automating could return incorrect evidence. Mitigation: Start with read-only evidence bundles and require reviewer sign-off for legal-sensitive items.
Risk: Scoring model misclassifies high-risk HIPAA asks. Mitigation: Conservative defaults -> route to Security/Legal and maintain human-in-loop during first 8 weeks.
Risk: Accessing telemetry requires infra changes. Mitigation: Scoped connector with narrow read permissions and phased rollout with Eng security review.
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Internal alpha with Security/Legal using synthetic requests
Week 3-6: Beta with Sales/Support on low-risk customers; collect labeling data for scorer
Week 7-10: Open to enterprise customers behind feature flag; expand evidence connectors
Week 11+: GA with monitoring, SLA dashboard, and retrospectives
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboard: incoming compliance request volume by type/region/tier
Alerts: sustained backlog > 24h for P1/P0 queues
Quality metric: misclassification incidents per week and reviewer override rate
